description: $0.02 USDC on Solana per endpoint - the payment buys one signed rail-coverage and reject-shape probe report: the published 7-probe set run against the named endpoint (baseline GET, HEAD, POST-unpaid, direct-rail garbage, facilitator-rail garbage, missing-memo, bogus-header), a grade per rail, the method matrix, and every named exposure finding. url.description: The one endpoint URL the 7-probe set runs against after payment. Probe responses are processed in memory only and never stored.
